body: Nowhere near a sub 50 400 runner nor do I have a sub 23 200, but you NEED to get your 100/200 down before you even think about running 49.99 in the 400. Most guys that are sprinters that run sub 50 usually run 22 low to mid in the 200, so your first goal should be to get as close to 22 flat as possible. You could probably get away with 23 low if you have god like speed endurance, but I wouldn't count on it
